name: Floating_Decision_DastnuristAntiDrugRally
title: Dastnurist Uproar Over Drugs
description: Influential Dastnurist religious leaders are condemning the government's lenient drug policies, stirring public outrage through sermons and demonstrations. Their growing influence threatens to destabilize the city as tensions between conservative and secular factions rise.

options.text: Deploy police and disperse them [+1 Authority]
Support moderate religious leaders to divide them [-1 Authority]
Revoke their permits and reduce funding for them [+1 Budget]
Calm them and create public health campaign [-1 Budget]

name: Floating_Decision_DastnuristApproval
title: The Oath of the Dastnurist Elders
description:
The Dastnurist elders have convened in Bronaz for a series of ceremonies and public declarations, drawing large crowds to witness their acts of devotion. In long processions, they march through the streets, reciting ancient verses to show support to the preserving of moral and religious traditions. From the sanctuary steps, their senior leaders have proclaimed loyalty to the monarchy, while urging followers to remain resistant against challenges to their faith. 

The city hums with the sound of prayer.

name: Floating_Decision_DastnuristProtestsOne
title: The Printing Scandal
description: A controversial printing house has released pamphlets critiquing the strict teachings of Dastnurity, sparking outrage among the clergy. Protests are growing, with demands to shut down the operation and confiscate the blasphemous materials.

options.text: Send police to disperse the rabble [+1 Authority]

name: Floating_Decision_DastnuristProtestsTwo
title: The Silent March
description: A massive silent march has been organized by Dastnurist clergy in the capital. Tens of thousands walk through the city streets, dressed in black and holding banners that condemn what they see as the crown’s disregard for religious purity. The marchers demand public recognition of their grievances and a return to stricter policies on moral governance.

options.text: Ban any future Dastnurist marches [+2 Authority]
Deploy Golden Guard to disperse them [+1 Authority]

name: Floating_Decision_DrugsFloodsPort
title: Ratspice and Yishyash Flood Port
description: The city is grappling with a surge of ratspice and yishyash smuggled in from Agard and Wehlen. The epidemic is straining hospitals, fueling crime, and threatening the royal family's image of control. With the city’s economy and reputation hanging in the balance, decisive but calculated action is needed to contain the crisis.

options.text: Deploy the royal house troops to restore order [-1 Authority]
Tighten coastal guard naval inspections offshore
Deploy the royal house troops to restore order
Bribe key dockworkers and smugglers to stop flow [-2 Budget]
Don't do anything [-1 Authority Per Turn]

name: Floating_Decision_ExpeditePlavoRestoration_One
title: Appoint Project Managers to Accelerate Restoration
description: The restoration of the Plavo Archsanctuary has faced delays due to management inefficiencies. Improving oversight and optimizing workflows could expedite progress, or the current management strategy could be adjusted with additional investment in leadership.
hubTitle: Appoint Project Managers to Accelerate Restoration

options.text: Hire top project managers for complete oversight [-2 Budget]
Promote local supervisors and provide advanced training [-1 Budget]
Continue with the current management but warn them
Hire Underhall Construction experts from Sordland [-1 Budget]
Contract experts from Rumburg's Spikeston Builders Incorporated [-1 Budget]

name: Floating_Decision_ExpeditePlavoRestoration_Two
title: Boost Resources to Expedite Plavo Construction
description: With management reorganized, the next challenge for accelerating the Plavo restoration lies in optimizing resources. Adjustments to logistics, tools, or workforce management could quicken progress, or the project could continue at its current steady pace.
hubTitle: Boost Resources to Expedite Plavo Construction

options.text: Invest in top-tier equipment and logistics [-2 Budget]
Improve workers’ basic living conditions [-1 Budget]
Maintain current allocation but increase pressure
Hire more labor hands for minimal cost [-1 Authority]
Force 18-hour shifts on the project [-2 Authority]

name: Floating_Decision_ExpediteSallabesExpansion_One
title: Construction Progresses Slowly
description: The construction of the Sallabes Grandsanctuary expansion is progressing slowly, and efforts are being made to accelerate the project. New construction techniques or invoking traditional practices may offer different paths forward.

options.text: Use prefabricated components from global market [-2 Budget]
Initiate provincial collaboration with Valenqiris [-1 Authority]
Perform a holy blessing to inspire workers instead
Continue with the current construction methods but increase pressure
Use prefabricated components from Taurus Holding [-1 Budget]

name: Floating_Decision_ExpediteSallabesExpansion_Two
title: Enhance Logistics and Transportation for Grandsanctuary Materials
description: Logistical challenges have slowed progress on the Sallabes Grandsanctuary expansion, but infrastructure or other aspects of the process could be improved to speed things up. Improving transportation efficiency will be key to keeping the project on track.
hubTitle: Enhance Logistics and Transportation for Materials

options.text: Hire an additional logistics company to help [-1 Budget]
Reorganize on-site logistics to minimize delays [-1 Authority]
Use sea routes and prioritize construction goods [-1 Authority, -1 Budget]
Use sea routes and prioritize construction goods
Open a new logistics route from Iza
Keep current logistical operations and warn leads

name: Floating_Decision_GangWarErupts
title: Gang War Erupts
description: The city of Jales is engulfed in a violent turf war between The Skinner Cartel and Nefandes Vulturio, a rising local gang known for its brutal tactics and growing influence. As these two ruthless factions battle for dominance over the city’s control, some streets have become war zones, civilians are caught in the crossfire, businesses are shuttering, and public trust in the authorities is crumbling.

options.text: Deploy Golden Guard to suppress both gangs [+1 Authority]
Send Su Omina to crush the gangs with brutal force
Back Nefandes Vulturio to eliminate the Skinners, then turn on them [-1 Authority, -1 Budget, -100 Military Equipment]
Choke their funding by targeting businesses tied to both gangs
Order House Sazon to handle it
Don't do anything [-1 Authority Per Turn]

name: Floating_Decision_GolcondistApproval
title: A Pilgrimage of Devotion
description:
A Golcondist pilgrimage has arrived in Plavo, transforming the streets into a procession of color and song. Devout worshippers kneel in rows as clergy lead prayers in the city squares, their voices rising in solemn harmony against the walls of ancient sanctuaries. Offerings of food and coin pile high at shrines, while banners bearing intricate symbols of faith flutter in the wind. 

The pilgrimage has drawn the attention of the local populace, many of whom gather to observe or participate in the rituals.

name: Floating_Decision_GolcondistProtestsOne
title: The Exile of Aurento Zanteno
description: Reports from Montaklar indicate that Aurento Zanteno, a Golcondist cleric, was forcibly removed from a Wruhecist sanctuary after attempting to pray there. This incident has stirred unrest among Golcondist communities, who are demanding recognition and assurances of fair treatment. Demonstrations have begun in Plavo and other towns.

options.text: Send Wruhecs Guardians to disperse [+1 Authority]
Send Su Omina to disperse protests [+1 Authority]
Send Golden Guard to disperse [+1 Authority]
Ignore the unrest [-1 Authority Per Turn]

name: Floating_Decision_GolcondistProtestsTwo
title: The Golcondist Blockade
description: Golcondist merchants and clergy have organized a blockade in Iza, disrupting trade and halting movement through key city districts. They demand an end to their faith’s exclusion from local councils and insist on greater support for their communities. The situation has already begun to affect local commerce and stability.

options.text: Break the blockade with police force
Negotiate a settlement with the leaders [-2 Authority]
Offer large financial incentives to end it [-3 Budget]
Send Golden Guard to disperse [+1 Authority]
Blame the reformists and the RPP

name: Floating_Decision_NationalDestabilization_Ended
title: Calming of the Capital's Chaos
description: The once-massive throng of protestors across Rizia, including in our very own capital, has begun to wane as their movement loses momentum. The Porte Drazon police department is registering fewer reports of property damage and violence against nobles. While individual cells of anti-monarchists remain active, the discord and conflict that plagued our streets mere weeks ago appears to be coming to an end.

options.text: Glad we didn't have to resort to more bloodshed

name: Floating_Decision_PalesReunificationCancelled
title: Duke Reinhart Cancels Reunification Efforts
description: Duke Axel Reinhart of Pales has decided to prematurely end reunification discussions, citing a number of concerns about recent events in Rizia. He assures us that the Grand Duchy will remain on amicable terms with us, and that his marriage to Princess Vina will remain stable.

name: Floating_Decision_PlavoRestoration_Event
title: Plavo Restoration Faces Delays Due to Lack of Specialists
description: The restoration of the Plavo Archsanctuary, has been hindered by a shortage of skilled restoration specialists. The options include hiring esteemed restoration experts from Porte Drazon known for their work on religious sites, seeking skilled artisans from the global market, or maintaining the current pace with local teams.
hubTitle: Archsanctuary Faces Delays Due to Lack of Specialists

options.text: Get specialists from the Romus Toras University
Hire experts from Porte Drazon [-1 Budget]
Hire experts from international market [-2 Budget]

name: Floating_Decision_ReformMovement_RadicalismGrows
title: Radical Elements Organize in Rizia
description:
Radical elements in Rizia are becoming more organized and vocal, particularly several revolutionary groups who are now under strict surveillance by the Rizian Intelligence, have been advocating for dismantling traditional power structures and shifting toward a socialist system. A leading workers rights advocate Adarfo Sotelato, who is also suspected of having ties to Valgsland, has gained popularity among these groups and is increasingly assuming the role of a leader for the growing Rizian radicals.

While these groups appear to be peaceful, the Intelligence warns that if their influence grows further, their extreme rhetoric may gain traction among those dissatisfied with the Crown.

name: Floating_Decision_ReformMovement_RadicalismGrows2
title: Growing Radicalism within the Reform Movement
description:
Radical groups, led by figures like Adarfo Sotelato, have firmly infiltrated the reform movement and are now steering the agenda toward extreme goals. These radicals are positioning themselves as the voice of the movement, sidelining moderates and increasing tensions across the country. They openly talk about revolutionary changes, including abolishing the monarchy and restructuring the government along Malenyevist lines.

Rizian Intelligence warns that the growing influence of these radicals could soon lead to widespread unrest.
condition: RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Radicalism >= 7 && RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Strength >= 5 && RiziaDLC.Decision_ReformMovement_Radicalism2_Happened == false && RiziaDLC.Decision_ReformMovement_Radicalism_Happened == true && (RiziaDLCSetup.CurrentTurn == 8 && RiziaDLC.Reform_Path == true) == false

options.text: Increase surveillance on RPP's Radical faction

name: Floating_Decision_ReformMovement_ReformMovementGrows
title: Reform Movement Grows
description:
The reform movement, spearheaded by the Rizian People's Party (RPP), is beginning to gain momentum across the nation. Reformist organizations and RPP party membership are growing in size, with tens of thousands of citizens turning out in major cities to demand the right to elect their political leaders and participate in shaping Rizian policy.

The Rizian Intelligence is closely monitoring these gatherings, reporting concerns that the movement is growing steadily and may continue to escalate. They report that the RPP's call for a new constitution is resonating with the public, and support for democratic reforms is gradually increasing.

options.text: Increase surveillance on the Reformist Movement

name: Floating_Decision_ReformMovement_ReformMovementGrows2
title: Reform Movement Grows
description: The reform movement has surged dramatically, becoming a national force impossible to ignore. Massive rallies organized by the Rizian People's Party and reformist groups are drawing hundreds of thousands, with calls for democratization echoing in every major city. The majority of the public is reported to be in support of the RPP's push for a new constitution, and pressure is mounting on the government to respond.

options.text: Deploy security forces to prevent further gatherings
Promise to listen to their concerns

name: Floating_Decision_ReligiousRevenues
title: Religious Proceeds Report by Office of Religious Affairs
description: The Office of Religious Affairs of the Grand Wiscerer has observed changes in the kingdom's religious proceeds. These encompass tithes, offerings, ceremonial dues, and other contributions from devoted followers and sacred activities.
hubTitle: Religious Proceeds Report by Office of Religious Affairs

name: Floating_Decision_RustyOffersLoan
title: Rusty Offers a Loan
description: Russello "Rusty" Montoro, CEO of Rizian Royal Gold, extends an offer: he is willing to lend the monarchy funds at a competitive interest rate.

options.text: Take a big loan [+4 Budget, -6 Repayment Later]
Take a small loan [+2 Budget, -3 Repayment Later]

name: Floating_Decision_SallabesExpansion_Event
title: Grandsanctuary Construction Faces Timber Shortage
description: The construction of the expansion to the Sallabes Dastnurist Grandsanctuary, is experiencing setbacks due to a critical shortage of quality timber. With the current high market demand for timber, obtaining the necessary resources has become a challenge. The options to address this include seeking alternative timber sources, though possibly at a higher cost. Another is using different construction materials, thus ensuring the sanctuary's aesthetic and spiritual integrity remains intact. Alternatively, the project could be delayed until the timber market stabilizes.

options.text: Purchase additional timber from international market. [-2 Budget]
Wait until needed timber is available

name: Floating_Decision_SanctuariesCompletionCelebrated
title: Religious Sanctuaries Completion Celebrated
description: Our nation rejoices as the restoration of the Plavo Sanctuary and the expansion of the Sallabes Grandsanctuary reach completion. These projects are not just architectural feats, but beacons of faith for the Wruhecist and Dastnurist communities alike. Their completion marks a significant step in nurturing the Nurity faith and promises to elevate the happiness of our religious citizens.

options.text: All our people will be enlightened by my divine rule
There is a place for all branches of Nurity in Rizia
Let Nur shine over my subjects

name: Floating_Decision_SkinnerCrackdown
title: Skinner Cartel Crackdown
description: The Skinner Cartel has entrenched itself, exploiting the city’s role as a key land route between Morella and Pales. Their smuggling operations run deep, with local officials and law enforcement turning a blind eye under threat or bribe. As cartel violence escalates and neighborhoods fall under their control, the city edges closer to collapse.

options.text: Launch a massive police operation [+1 Authority]
Send Su Omina to take over enforcement
Call on local Wruhecists to stop the cartel
Weaponize urban redevelopment to displace them [-1 Budget]
Order House Azaro to handle it
Don't do anything [-1 Authority Per Turn]

name: Floating_Decision_StockExchangeLeader
title: Appointing Stock Exchange Leadership
description: The newly established Porte Drazon Stock Exchange requires its first leader. The appointment will signal the kingdom's economic direction and set the tone for investor confidence. Who will take the helm?

options.condition: RiziaDLC.Rusty_Arrested == false && RiziaDLC.Rusty_Fled == false && RiziaDLC.Rusty_Executed == false

name: Floating_Decision_SurgeinTourismRevenue
title: Surge in Tourism Revenue
description: The kingdom's reputation as a safe and enchanting destination has led to a significant increase in tourism. This boom has subsequently boosted treasury revenues, presenting a unique opportunity for economic advancement. The economic windfall presents an opportunity to allocate these newfound funds to the treasury. [+3 Budget]

options.text: Rizia is a gate to the world

name: Floating_Decision_TraffickingRoutes
title: Drug Routes Converge
description: The inland crossroads city known for its bustling markets and vital transport links, has become a key hub in the regional drug trade. Smugglers exploit its road and rail networks to move narcotics, often hidden among legitimate goods. The local economy thrives on this flow of commerce, blurring the lines between lawful trade and illicit activity.

options.text: Disrupt transport networks with random inspections
Cut deals with merchant guilds to expose smugglers. [-1 Budget]
Stage a high-profile public trial of captured smugglers. [+1 Authority]
Coordinate with Morella to improve border security
Encourage vigilante justice through local communities [-1 Authority, -100 Military Equipment]
Don't do anything [-1 Authority Per Turn]

name: Floating_Decision_UniversityOfTheologyBranches
title: Defining the University’s Nurity Curriculum
description: The South Merkopan University of Theology construction has been completed and the operational activity is starting. The Office of Religious Affairs of the Grand Wiscerer requires a decision on which branches of Nurity the institution will teach.

name: Floating_Decision_ValenqirisEnvironmentCrisis
title: Addressing Valenqiris Environmental Crisis
description: The Valenqiris region, renowned for its natural splendor and vital industries, faces an environmental crisis. Recent economic developments have led to significant ecological damage, affecting tourism, agriculture, and the local wine industry. This dire situation calls for decisive action to mitigate the environmental impact and restore the region's health.

options.text: Take no action, accepting current state

name: Floating_Decision_War_TopGuardFlightAcademy
title: Build Top Guard Flight School
description: Commanders at Romus Toras Military Academy have proposed adding a specialized training wing to develop elite pilots, enhancing the kingdom’s air strength and strategic deterrence capabilities. The 'Top Guard Flight School' initiative would require a sizable investment but could significantly elevate the nation's power and influence on the international stage.

options.text: Build the Flight School [-2 Budget, -1 Authority]
Our funds are better used elsewhere

name: Floating_Decision_WruhecistApproval
title: A Convocation of Wruhecist Clergy
description:
Wruhecist clergy from across the region have gathered in Valenqir for a grand convocation, filling the city’s largest sanctuary halls and public spaces with prayers and hymns. The spiritual leaders have declared their allegiance to the monarchy, urging their followers to stand firm in their faith and loyalty. 

The streets are lined with banners bearing holy symbols, and the mood is one of solemn reverence as thousands look to the crown for guidance.

name: Floating_Decision_WruhecistProtestsOne
title: The Desecration of the Sanctuary
description: A group of atheist radicals has vandalized a sacred Wruhecist sanctuary, destroying relics and defiling its walls with anti-religious slogans. The clergy call for protection of religious sites and justice for those responsible, even as protests continue to grow.

options.text: Denounce the act and call for unity
Fund repairs for the sanctuary [-2 Budget]
Punish and arrest the secular groups
Send police to disperse the Wruhecist protestors

name: Floating_Decision_WruhecistProtestsTwo

description: Prominent Wruhecist clerics have begun delivering fiery sermons in open squares, openly accusing the monarchy of attacking their religion. Thousands of followers have gathered in the streets, creating an atmosphere of unrest. Clerics call for a greater role in governance and warn against ignoring the sacred traditions of the faith.

options.text: Deploy House Azaro’s forces to restore order [+2 Authority]
Send RNC and RPP delegates to negotiate [-2 Authority]
Permit their sermons, but monitor closely
Bribe loyalist clerics to divide and conquer [-6 Budget]

We are no longer able to provide the requirements for our energy deal with Derdia. In order to extend the deadline they have given us for the next planned energy delivery, we can pay a one-time sum instead.

If we do not agree to their demands, they will cancel the energy transfer.

name: OP1_Decision_War_Played_Airfield17_Captured
title: Aledorad Airfield Captured
description: Our troops have taken control of Aledorad Ridge Airfield, uncovering several enemy bombers that, while damaged, could be valuable assets. Repairing and integrating the bombers in to our own fleet will require significant manpower and resources. Destroying the airfield and everything on it will prevent the enemy from reclaiming it but at the cost of losing potentially relevant units.

options.text: Repair and integrate enemy bombers into our own fleet. [-500 Equipment, -500 Manpower]

name: OP1_Decision_War_Played_Airfield29_Captured
title: Arces Airfield Occupied
description: Our troops have secured the strategically vital Arces Central Military Airfield, placing us within close range of the nearby city of Arces. Should we leverage the airfield's position to our advantage as long as we maintain control, or destroy it to prevent the enemy from using it in the future?

options.text: Launch offensive strike on Arces [-500 Equipment, -500 Manpower]

name: OP1_Decision_War_Played_AntiAirTile14_Captured
title: Captured Anti-Air Base
description: Amidst the escalating conflict, our forces have captured a strategic anti-air base from enemy control. This facility, equipped with advanced radar systems and missile defense capabilities, offers a significant tactical advantage to whoever holds it.

options.text: Destroy the base to prevent enemy recapture
Hold the base for our military advantage

title: Fall of Fort Ales
description: Fort Ales, a linchpin in our border defenses and a staging ground for incursions into Pales, has fallen into enemy hands. Due to the cities' strategic position at the border, its capture not only emboldens enemy resistance but also opens up a critical pathway for counter-invasions into our heartland.

options.text: Cede Fort Ales and push forward
Launch a counterattack to reclaim Fort Ales [-250 Manpower]

name: OP1_Decision_War_Played_IntelSpyInSolles
title: Rescue of Intelligence Agent
description: In the aftermath of our capture of Arces, a high-ranking enemy military officer was taken into custody. During the interrogation, the official revealed a potentially game-changing piece of intel: One of our most valuable intelligence agents is being held captive in the western city of Solles. The veracity of this claim is uncertain, casting a shadow of doubt over the motivations behind the disclosure.

options.text: Launch a rescue mission for the agent
Disregard the official's claims as deceitful

name: OP1_Decision_War_Played_IntelVinaInSolles
title: Princess Vina's Location
description: In the aftermath of our capture of Arces, a high-ranking enemy military officer was taken into custody. options.text: Launch a rescue mission for Princess Vina

title: Refugees in the Battlefield
description: As the relentless war rages on, the town of Limana is witnessing a massive influx of desperate civilians fleeing from the conflict zone. The escaping refugees are in need of supplies and equipment to help them reach safer lands.

options.text: Set up refugee camps [-100 Manpower, -1 Budget]

name: OP1_Decision_War_Played_OnStartBattleWesternAledoApproach
title: Western Approach of the Aledo Mountains
description: The western approach to the Aledo Mountains has become a pivotal battleground between Rizian and Palesian forces. With the enemy's entrenched forces offering them a commanding view over the region, we need to determine how to cross the mountains.
hubTitle: Western Approach of the Aledo Mountains

name: OP1_Decision_War_Played_RizianIntelligenceDestroysTank
title: Rizian Sabotage in Palesian Ranks
description: A spectacular covert operation within the fortified enemy territories west of Ziqes resulted in the crippling of a crucial enemy division. Our intelligence operatives not only sabotaged a key communications relay but also instigated defections among several officers.

name: OP1_Decision_War_Played_Terador_Captured
title: Fall of Terador
description: In an unexpected turn of events, the city of Terador has fallen into the clutches of enemy forces. With the enemy fortifying their position within Terador's ancient walls, the city is now a symbol of our vulnerability and a strategic point that cannot remain under hostile control.

options.text: Cede the city and push forward
Launch a counter-offensive to reclaim Terador [-250 Manpower]

name: OP1_Decision_War_Played_Use_Experimental_Weapons_Arces
title: Request for Nerve Gas Usage in Arces
description: Our leaders have proposed deploying the experimental nerve agent again in order to capture Arces. They contend that this approach would speed up the siege's conclusion, ultimately resulting in fewer losses.
hubTitle: Request for Nerve Gas Usage in Arces

title: Request for Experimental Weapon Usage in Arces

description: The promised Derdian missile system has arrived on our shores, providing a powerful tool in the conflict with Pales. Each option promises to change the dynamics of the battlefield, but resources limit us to a single decisive strike.

name: OP2_Decision_UseDerdianMissilesTwo
title: Use Derdian Missiles
description: A second wave of the Derdian missile system is now primed for deployment. Striking the enemy navy during their refueling at port could sever vital supply lines and disrupt naval support, creating an opening for a strategic offensive.

options.text: Strike Navy at the Port of Pales
Strike Navy at the Port of Remaz

name: OP2_Decision_War_Played_Airfield65_Captured
title: Messes Airfield Captured
description: Our forces have successfully captured Pales' Messus Valley Military Airfield, discovering aircraft in various states of damage. Their integration into our operations will yet again require substantial manpower and material resources. Alternatively, destroying the airfield entirely will deny its use to the enemy but squander potential valuable assets.

options.text: Repair and integrate enemy bombers into our own fleet. [-500 Equipment, -500 Manpower]

name: OP2_Decision_War_Played_Airfield71_Captured
title: Adiyoces Airfield Seized
description: After the takeover of the vital Adiyoces Military Airfield, our units find themselves within range of the city of Remaz. We must decide on the best use of this strategic advantage: whether to destroy the airfield to prevent enemy use, or to maintain its functionality for our own strikes.

options.text: Launch offensive strike on Remaz [-500 Equipment, -500 Manpower]

name: OP2_Decision_War_Played_DestroyEnemyShip
title: Palesian Command Base Seized
description: Our forces uncovered and seized a hostile naval command base. The facility, hidden along the coast, was previously thought impossible to locate. The capture of high-ranking officers and crucial intelligence data has significantly disrupted Pales' naval efforts.

options.text: I hope this is not a trap...

name: OP2_Decision_War_Played_Discovered_Mass_Grave
title: Mass Grave Discovered
description: In the aftermath of a fierce battle, a mass grave was unearthed on the outskirts of a conquered town. Upon investigation it was found out that the Derdian mercenaries we hired are responsible for the massacre. The discovery, laden with the remains of countless unidentified soldiers and civilians, stirred deep emotions among our troops and local residents.

options.text: Honor the victims with a dignified burial
Suppress the truth to avoid international backlash

name: OP2_Decision_War_Played_MilitiaSpawn
title: Ziqes and Arces Rise Up!
description: Amidst the chaos of war, occupied Ziqes and Arces rebelled against our rule, challenging our already strained resources. The local populace, driven to desperation by war-induced hardships and neglect, demands immediate change, their people demanding an improvement to their living conditions and an end to occupation.

name: OP2_Decision_War_Played_Pales_Official_Escaped
title: The Fugitive of Remaz
description: Our dismissal of the Pales official's offer of cooperation led to unforeseen consequences. The official fled to the heart of Pales, carrying with him details of our previous capture of Remaz. Armed with this information, the enemy has fortified its capital, complicating our invasion efforts.

options.text: We were right not to trust him

name: OP2_Decision_War_Played_Remaz_Captured
title: Crucial Intel
description: After Remaz's capture, an enemy officer proposes a lucrative bargain: his knowledge of Pales' defenses for us guaranteeing his family's safe passage.

name: OP2_Decision_War_Played_RescueSpy_Tile73
title: A Coastal Rescue
description: After months of searching and piecing together scattered intelligence, the location of our captured intelligence agent has finally been uncovered. The rescue mission's success hinges on a swift and decisive operation, with the element of surprise being paramount. However, the treacherous terrain and the proximity to enemy reinforcements pose significant risks.

name: OP2_Decision_War_Played_RescueSpy_Tile73_Failed
title: The Failed Rescue
description: Amidst the chaos the defenders managed to repel the brunt of the attack, dragging away our agent to an unknown location. The aftermath left our command in disarray, as the chances of locating and saving him became even slimmer.

name: OP2_Decision_War_Played_RescueSpy_Tile73_Success
title: A Successful Rescue
description: In a daring night operation, Rizian forces rescued one of their own agents, whose intelligence on the city of Pales promises to be the key to its capture. The successful mission was fueled by information extracted from a Palesian official under intense interrogation.

name: OP2_Decision_War_Played_SpyNotInSolles
title: False Intel
description: Acting on the information about our intelligence agent being held captive in the city of Solles, our forces attacked and successfully captured the city, anticipating a swift rescue. However, upon securing the city and interrogating the local officials, it became glaringly evident that the intel was a ruse; The agent is nowhere to be found within the city's confines.

options.text: Direct our troops at the front to the rescue

name: OP2_Decision_War_Played_Suprise_VinaRescue_Tile73
title: Princess Vina's Rescue
description: After taking control of a secluded stretch along the shores of Pales, the strike team uncovered evidence of a concealed enemy facility buried beneath the ruins. Pushing deeper into the hidden base, they were stunned to find Princess Vina imprisoned in a reinforced chamber. Her unexpected rescue turned the mission on its head, setting the stage for a bold new phase in the campaign.

name: OP2_Decision_War_Played_Use_Experimental_Weapons_FirstTime_Pales
title: Request for Experimental Weapon Usage in Pales
description: Our military leaders on the ground are seeking permission to employ the recently obtained nerve gas agent from Rumburg in the siege of Pales. They aim to evaluate the weapon's effectiveness and explore its potential to quickly bring an end to the hostilities.

name: OP_Tutorial_Turn1
title: War Objective
description: The War Objective <sprite name="objective"> is capturing the enemy cities in a certain time frame, while simultaneously protecting your own cities from enemy attack.

name: OP_Tutorial_Turn2
title: Sea Battle
description:
To capture an enemy city, it can be helpful to cut it off from its supply line first. Try attacking the enemy Submarine with a Military Ship by selecting the Military Ship and clicking on the Submarine. Naval Units don't have to be on adjacent tiles to start a battle, and can move several tiles at once. 

Note: Naval Units such as Military Ships and Flag Ships can support land and sea battle, but cannot attack land units directly. Submarines can only support sea battles.

name: OP_Tutorial_Turn3
title: Naval Support
description: Supporting a land battle from sea can be powerful. Try moving and attacking with a unit on a shore tile, to make naval support possible.

name: Turn01_Decision_CoronationCelebrations
title: Coronation Celebrations
description: The Rizian public is eager to celebrate their new king's coronation. Investing in lavish celebrations could make a good first impression and earn their favor.

options.text: A small parade in the capital Porte Drazon
Parades and banquets in major cities [-1 Budget, +1 Authority]
Parades and banquets in major cities [-1 Budget]
Parades, banquets and balls in all cities [-2 Budget, +3 Authority]
Parades, banquets and balls in all cities [-2 Budget]

name: Turn01_Decision_InfrastructureProject
title: Invest in Mega-Infrastructure
description: The Ministry of Economy has put forward two bold plans for mega-infrastructure projects that would help with the economic recession in the long term. Investing in projects of this scale will take up some portion of our budget but could prove worthwhile if accomplished successfully.

options.text: Invest in a mega-infrastructure project [-1 Government Budget]

name: Turn01_Decision_InvestInRizianFootballFederation
title: Investing in the Rizian Football Federation
description: The Rizian Football Federation is at a crossroads. Real Montaklar remains a global icon, while FC Porte Drazon, an ambitious but smaller club, struggles in their shadow. The choice of investment strategy could significantly influence the future trajectory of Rizian football, either by bolstering the prestige of an already renowned club or by nurturing emerging talents to foster a more competitive domestic landscape.
hubTitle: Investing in the Rizian Football Industry
endInstruction: SetRichPresence("Kicking around the future of Rizian football", "Palace Rezna", "Porte Drazon");

options.text: Invest in FC Porte Drazon [-1 Budget]
Balanced investment in both clubs [-2 Budget]

name: Turn01_Decision_PersonalInvestment
title: Invest in Arcasian Company Stocks
description: A personal investment opportunity has been relayed by Mr. Manger. An experienced stock broker in Ventrie City, Arcasia is selling valuable shares of Armadine Industries: an up and coming electronics manufacturing company. We could invest or let the opportunity pass.

name: Turn01_Decision_RoyaltyConcertEvent
title: Arrange a Classical Concert for the Noble Houses
description: As a gesture to the Noble Houses and to celebrate the cultural music heritage, a proposal to host an extravagant classical concert featuring the renowned Rizian composer, Antonio Geria Albeni has been made. This event could serve as a display of the monarchy's support of the arts and reinforce its prestigious image among the Noble Houses.
hubTitle: Arrange a Classical Concert for the Noble Houses

name: Turn02_Decision_ArmySpecialForcesDivisions
title: Special Forces Division
description: To bolster our defense capabilities and ensure rapid response to emerging threats, it is proposed to establish a dedicated Special Forces Division. This elite unit would be specialized, honed for operations in unique terrains and high-stakes scenarios. By tailoring their training and equipment, the aim is to optimize their effectiveness in diverse conditions and challenges.
endInstruction: SetRichPresence("Forming new special forces divisions", "Folce Dator", "Montaklar");

name: Turn02_Decision_BanMalenyevistPropaganda
title: Revolutionary Propaganda Ban
description: Books, magazines and pamphlets from Malenyevist countries such as United Contana, Valgsland and Galmland have been reaching our shores. These seemingly innocuous reading materials have the potential to lead to the spread of socialist thought among the populace.

name: Turn02_Decision_EconomicRelief
title: Economic Relief Plan
description: With the assistance of the National Business Council and the Central Bank, Symon Holl put forward a country-wide relief plan to mitigate the economic hardships that are being felt. We can either provide stimulus cheques for people in need or bailout businesses under serious financial strain or decide not to approve the plan. [-2 Government Budget]

options.text: Provide stimulus cheques for people in need

name: Turn02_Decision_EsqirisFieldRunningOut_PenaltyWarning
title: Esqiris Gas Field Reserves Alert
description:
The iconic Esqiris Gas Field, a beacon of Rizia's energy prowess since 1921, is sending distress signals. Recent reports indicate dwindling reserves at an alarming rate. While it has been a consistent contributor to Rizia's energy matrix, its operational future now seems precarious. 

Without immediate and targeted surveys, followed by potential offshore excavations, the gas field is projected to cease operations in the coming years. [-1 Energy Per Turn in Future]

options.text: The Kingdom will find a solution by decree
There is nothing we can do

name: Turn02_Decision_FamilyStatues
title: Commission Toras Family Statues
description: There has been a proposition to erect statues across the nation in honor of the grand legacy of House Toras. The choices are varied: one that honors King Valero, another showcasing the late king alongside his son Romus, or a grand portrayal of the entire recent Toras lineage.

options.text: Commission statues of Valero and Romus [-1 Budget, +1 Authority]
Commission for entire Toras Family [-2 Budget, +2 Authority]

name: Turn02_Decision_Funeral
title: Funeral of Bernard Circas
description: The death of Bernard Circas has shocked the country and his funeral will be held in Deyr among a large crowd of sympathizers. Circas was not only a communist poet but also an elected MP that had a voice. A state funeral has been organized to honor him. The question is whether the President and the administration will attend the funeral or not.

name: Turn02_Decision_IncludeWernerTrade
title: Bring Elena to Sordland Trade Discussion
description: The Sordish delegation is expected to bring up the re-opening of Sordish-Rizian trade relations during their upcoming visit. While Treasury Councilor Elena Werner would normally be present for such a discussion, Development Minister Gus Manger has requested to speak with the King alone.

name: Turn02_Decision_NelvisarFieldShutsDown_Penalty
title: Nelvisar Oil Field Closure
description:
A significant chapter in Rizia's oil history is drawing to a close. The Nelvisar Oil Field at Folce Dator, an instrumental asset since its discovery in 1895, faces imminent shutdown. Despite the depletion of its once-abundant reserves, the field has continually played a role in meeting Rizia's oil demands. 

Under the steadfast management of Rizian Oil and Gas, the field has stood the test of time, but nature's limits are becoming evident. [-1 Energy Per Turn]

options.text: Where one door closes, another opens

name: Turn02_Decision_OrganizedCrime_PenaltyWarning
title: Law Enforcement Losing Grip in Districts
description: Several provincial reports describe a rise in unexplained violence, sudden erosion in local control, and some uncooperative police posts. Certain low-income neighborhoods have grown difficult to enter without warning or resistance.
hubTitle: Law Enforcement Losing Grip in Districts

options.text: We need to look at our internal security situation
The police are choosing to look away

name: Turn02_Decision_SaveArufeldeOrg
title: Save the Arufelde
description: The Morella-based nonprofit coalition "Save the Arufelde" is organizing a campaign to raise awareness around the pollution of the Arufelde river watershed. They claim the river has been contaminated by heavily acidic wastewater runoff from the mines in the nearby Meftiem International Trade Zone. They are asking the Trade Zone's stakeholders, including Rizia, for their financial support.
hubTitle: "Save the Arufelde" Campaign Asks for Support

name: Turn02_Decision_StatusReaction
title: React to the Unrest
description: The political situation around the country has escalated. Chief Strategist Lucian Galade has prepared several action plans that we can execute. What will we do to address the intensifying political climate?

options.text: Call for restraint on national television
Expand the police by deploying all recruits in training

name: Turn03_Decision_BrokenTraditions_PenaltyWarning
title: Insinuations In the Palace Halls
description: Recent shifts in royal conduct have prompted quiet conversation among palace staff and provincial representatives. Complaining that certain traditional courtesies are being set aside, a few officials appear slower to respond to orders than usual. It may be nothing, but the atmosphere has changed.

options.text: I've done nothing out of the ordinary
They’ll get used to it in time

name: Turn03_Decision_DiplomaticEnvoyChoice
title: Send Diplomatic Envoy to Improve Relations
description: In a bid to strengthen international relations and fortify alliances, it's proposed to send a diplomatic envoy to a nation of our choice: Pales, Wehlen, Derdia, or Morella. The success of this mission could lead to enhanced trade, cooperation, and mutual understanding.  [-1 Authority, -1 Budget]
hubTitle: Send Diplomatic Envoy to Improve Relations

options.text: Don't send. [No Authority and Budget Cost]

name: Turn03_Decision_Extraction
title: Leave Gasom Facility and Narbel
description: A volatile situation has emerged outside the Gasom facility, with a sizeable crowd of protestors amassing. Their grievances, fueled by underlying tensions, present a complex scenario for us to navigate. The decisions on our course of action could dramatically influence the outcome of this situation.

options.text: Address the protestors and leave via car

name: Turn03_Decision_FootballIndustryFalling_PenaltyWarning
title: Football Industry Shows Signs of Stagnation
description:
The Rizian Football Federation has expressed concerns over the diminishing quality and appeal of the national football leagues, particularly the second and third tiers. This decline not only impacts the cultural fabric of Rizia but also poses economic challenges. 

The Federation is contemplating various strategies to invigorate the industry, ranging from increased funding and marketing efforts to introducing foreign talent to enhance competitiveness.
hubTitle: Football Industry Shows Signs of Stagnation

options.text: We will ensure our football industry meets its goals
The industry should be able to stand on its own two feet

name: Turn03_Decision_GolcondistPilgrimsAccess
title: Golcondist Pilgrims Demand Access at Morella Border
description: A considerable congregation of devout Golcondist pilgrims from Derdia and Morella has congregated at the Point Darte border crossing seeking entry into Rizia for their sacred pilgrimage. Allowing these pilgrims to cross into Rizia could boost global image as a bastion of tolerance and compassion. However, these groups may intend to visit holy sites that are currently restricted under our laws.
hubTitle: Golcondist Pilgrims Demand Access at Morella Border

name: Turn03_Decision_IzaPoliceTransfer
title: Iza Police Transfer
description: Duke Rico Toras of Iza has requested the transfer of additional police forces to his direct control to crack down on the recent upswing in crime. These reinforcements would be drawn from the federally controlled Central Police headquartered in Rizia Imperii.

name: Turn03_Decision_LowPopularity_PenaltyWarning
title: Rumblings from the Streets and Taverns
description: The court has heard rumors of rising discontent among the lower quarters. Complaints echo in village halls, market alleys, and radio corners. Nothing explosive yet, just a persistent sense that the public is no longer looking up to their rulers with the same regard.
hubTitle: Rumblings from the Streets and Taverns

options.text: Some bread and circus will take care of this
They’ve stopped their praise. That’s how it begins.

name: Turn03_Decision_OrganizedCrime_Penalty
title: Organized Crime Undermines Local Control
description: Coordinated criminal networks are now operating with visible confidence. Reports show interference in police duties, the disappearance of key informants, and manipulated court procedures. Drug flow is accelerating, and certain areas now operate under informal gang rule. Local officials request stronger coordination from the center. [Negative Authority Per Turn]

options.text: The Crown is supreme, our authority will crush them
A minor problem, unworthy of our attention

name: Turn03_Decision_ProvincialTaxSubsidy
title: Provincial Tax Subsidy
description: Now that we have visited all of the provinces, we have the opportunity to grant a provincial tax subsidy to one of them. This will reduce our government income but will improve relations with the provincial house. [-2 Budget, -1 Budget Per Turn]
endInstruction: SetRichPresence("Deciding on subsidies for their kingdom’s provinces", "Palace Rezna", "Porte Drazon");

name: Turn03_Decision_StabilityOrder
title: Stability Order of 1954
description: An investigation on the influence of the Young Sords and Red Youth organizations on the post-assassination unrest has concluded. Neither youth group has officially organized or endorsed illegal actions, but several low- to mid-level leaders from both have links to inciting incidents that resulted in deaths, injuries and instability. This provides us with legal grounds to ban both organizations.

options.text: Ban the Red Youth and the Young Sords

name: Turn03_Decision_ZilleBombApology
title: Apologize for Inflammatory Speech
description: Wehlen is expecting the Rizian government to apologize for the inflammatory speech given just prior to the Zille bombing.

name: Turn03_Decision_ZilleBombDenounceSO
title: Statement on the Zille Incident
description: The press is expecting an official government statement from Rizia in the wake of the Zille incident. In particular, they expect the King to either denounce or defend the nationalist group Su Omina, who have been accused of being involved in the bombing.

options.text: Denounce and distance the crown from Su Omina
Defend and proclaim the innocence of Su Omina

name: Turn04_Decision_BrokenTraditions_Penalty
title: Tradition No Longer Taken for Granted
description: Minor delays and hesitations are becoming more and more common across civil channels, as bureaucrats claim confusion caused by the dissolution of old protocols. No one is refusing to act, but it’s clear some are questioning the way things are done now. [Negative Authority Per Turn]
hubTitle: Tradition No Longer Taken for Granted
condition: RiziaDLC.Decision_Floating_BrokenTraditions_PenaltyWarning == true && RiziaDLC.PersonalValue_BrokeTradition >= 3 && RiziaDLC.Reform_Path == false && RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RNCWinsSeats == false

options.text: They follow the Crown, not the King
We will deal with them soon enough
The cowards won't show their faces

name: Turn04_Decision_EastTradeReduced_PenaltyWarning
title: CSP Deliveries Slowing
description: Port authorities and trade offices have reported a decline in the volume and consistency of goods arriving from CSP nations. Some shipments are arriving late, others lighter than expected. There’s been no official change in agreements, but the shift is being felt across procurement channels.
condition:
RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Caleqabiz_ValgslandCSP == false &&
RiziaDLC.Trait_CommieKing == false && ((RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Valgsland_Hostile == true || RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Valgsland_Unfriendly == true) &&(RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Revolutionaries_Dangerous == true || RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Morella_Hostile == true || RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Morella_Unfriendly == true))

options.text: Our ties can still be mended

name: Turn04_Decision_FoundationDonation
title: Alphonso Foundation Asks For Donation
description: The Alphonso Foundation, known for its philanthropic efforts, is launching an expansive fundraising campaign and asking for donations. The mission at its heart is two-fold: addressing the homelessness crisis and battling income inequality in our society.

name: Turn04_Decision_GolcondistPilgrimsPlavo
title: Golcondist Pilgrims Squat Plavo Sanctuary
description: A group of Derdian Golcondist pilgrims, suspected to have entered the country via the Morellan border, have taken up residence unlawfully in the revered Plavo Archsanctuary. The monarchy now faces the choice: extradite these pilgrims to Derdia or Morella, or provide them with accommodation, ensuring their safety and upholding Golcondist religious sentiment.

options.text: Allow them to stay and pay for their accommodation [-1 Authority , -1 Budget]

name: Turn04_Decision_GRACETradeWeakens_Penalty
title: Tackling GRACE Trade Decline
description:
Recent reports indicate a troubling decrease in trade volume with GRACE, a key economic organization. This downturn is impacting the treasury, necessitating immediate and effective responses. 

Options include appealing to Rumburg and our other GRACE partners, exploring alternative trade partners, or investing in domestic industries to reduce reliance. [-2 Authority Per Turn, -1 Budget Per Turn]

options.text: Rizia will find newer and better alternatives
It's time we started distancing ourselves

name: Turn04_Decision_GruniRuralDevelopment
title: Gruni Rural Development Investment
description:
The Gruni Rural Development Investment is a proposal by Rural Development Minister Gus Manger to bolster Sordland's rural economies and secure the nation's food sustainability. The plan envisages a judicious allocation of resources to vitalize agricultural communities, fortify food security, and elevate the regional economy of Gruni.

One potential strategy is the provision of subsidies for new farms, encouraging more players into the agricultural field. Alternatively, Manger proposes an investment in the mechanization of existing farms to improve productivity or the initiation of crop research to foster innovation.

options.text: Subsidies for new farms [-2 Government Budget]
Initiate new crop research [-1 Government Budget]

name: Turn04_Decision_HouseOfDelegates_Attend
title: Attend House of Delegates Session
description: Rizian People's Party leader Manus Sazon has invited the King to attend a session of the House of Delegates. He is slated to propose what he has called a landmark proposal regarding the rights of workers in the kingdom.

options.text: Attend the session and give the final ruling on the proposal in question
Send your Grand Vizier to attend instead

name: Turn04_Decision_LowPopularity_Penalty
title: Support for the Crown Wanes
description: Opinion figures show a steep drop in public confidence. Civil servants report pushback from communities, and state campaigns are met with indifference or ridicule. There are increasing delays in cooperation from some local opposition leaders, who are growing wary of associating too closely with Palace directives. [Negative Authority Per Turn]
condition: RiziaDLC.Decision_Floating_LowPopularity_PenaltyWarning == true && RiziaDLC.Country_PublicOpinion <= -3 || (RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_MultiProvincialProtest == true || RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_LargeProvincialProtest == true || RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_ViolentProtests_RiziaImperii == true || RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization == true || RiziaDLC.Unrest_Nationalist_Grows == true || RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows == true || RiziaDLC.Unrest_Religious_Grows == true || RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_WruhecistCommunity_Dissatisfied == true)

options.text: They remember what we’ve taken, not what we’ve given.
We will win their hearts back soon.

name: Turn04_Decision_MalenyevistRevolutionaries_PenaltyWarning
title: Border Guard Reports Mounting Concerns
description: The Border Guards have flagged a growing number of irregularities along the Rizia-Morella frontier. Suspicious patterns of movement and unusual activity near checkpoints have increased. Officials are advising caution but have yet to identify anything concrete.

name: Turn04_Decision_PlayChessWithLucian
title: Lucian Offers to Play Chess
description: Late in the evening, Lucian extends an invitation for a strategic game of chess within the solemn quiet of the Presidential Office.

options.text: Don't play and relax at home with family

name: Turn04_Decision_PublicTransportationWeak_PenaltyWarning
title: Public Transportation Inefficiency Crisis
description:
The public transportation system is grappling with an efficiency crisis, strained by burgeoning demands and passenger numbers. Transportation officials are pushing for urgent action, highlighting the need for increased funding and modernization. The government must decide between investing in infrastructural improvements, technological upgrades, or exploring alternative transit solutions. 

The outcome will crucially impact the daily lives of the citizens and the efficiency of urban mobility.

options.text: The Rizian infrastructure network is our backbone
Our infrastructure will withstand the test of time

name: Turn04_Decision_ReactToWelfareProtestors
title: React To Welfare Protestors
description: A substantial crowd has amassed at the Palace Toras gates in Monqiz, vocalizing their concerns over the lack of access to higher quality education and healthcare services. Some voicing concerns with increasingly difficult living conditions. The Crown can choose to disperse them, allow their peaceful protest, or offer assurances to improve welfare spending across the nation.
endInstruction:
RiziaDLC.Protests_Welfare_Happened = true;
SetRichPresence("Facing angry crowds", "Palace Toras", "Monqiz");

options.text: Offer assurances [Promise Increased Health and Education Funds]

name: Turn04_Decision_RegionalInvestment
title: Regional Investment Decision
description: Gus Manger and Symon Holl have prepared an extensive regional investment package to revitalize one of top three economically fragile regions by boosting the municipality budgets, providing large sums of business grants and giving cheap loans to companies with liquidity problems. The proposal can be implemented in one of the following regions: Bergia, Lorren and Agnland or not. [-2 Government Budget]

name: Turn04_Decision_RiotGear
title: Buy Riot Control Equipment
description: The recent unrest has shown weaknesses in our law enforcement's ability to maintain order and peace. The Ministry of Interior has run out of important vehicles, armor and other crowd control gear to be able to ensure stability in the country. Should we fund riot control equipment?

options.text: Buy riot control equipment [-1 Government Budget]

name: Turn04_Decision_RRGStakeChange
title: Rizian Royal Gold Stake Change
description: In exchange for rejecting the Rizian People's Party's proposal for gold mining regulations, Rusty Montoro of Rizian Royal Gold has given us the opportunity to raise or lower the royal stake in his company.

options.text: Raise stake to 45 percent [-5 Budget, +2 Budget Per Turn]
Lower stake to 15 percent [+6 Budget, -2 Budget Per Turn]
Keep stake the same for now
I can't afford to raise the stake now, I'll decide later

name: Turn04_Decision_SordlandOffersInvestment
title: Sordland Offers Investment Opportunity
description: Amidst a recession, Sordland's government, led by Alphonso, has presented a potentially lucrative bond sale trade opportunity to be discussed at the capital of Sordland, Holsord. This royal visit will include the household and has additional expenditures.

options.text: Hold talks in Holsord to discuss the opportunity [-1 Budget]

name: Turn04_Decision_VendonesamAidRequest
title: Confederacy of Vendonesam Requests Support in Uprising
description:
With instability in key states of the Confederacy such as the Sultanate of Ragkara, Holy Isles of Penguvi, and the Duchy of Tamaren, the situation is rapidly deteriorating. Prince Consort Kabauen Sang Tam leads the effort to maintain monarchic control and suppress the uprising, but their resources are stretched thin. 

In a request for GRACE solidarity, Vendonesam turns to the Guild for assistance.
hubTitle: Confederacy of Vendonesam Requests Support in Uprising

options.text: Send extensive military equipment [-500 Military Equipment, -50 Support Vehicles]
Send some military equipment [-250 Military Equipment, -25 Support Vehicles]

name: Turn04_Decision_War_UpgradeProductionLinesOne
title: Upgrade Military Production Lines
description: The kingdom’s recently built, modern military factories offer a solid foundation to scale up production of Land and Air Units. An expansion would enable the kingdom to strengthen its position, either by preparing for potential conflicts or by establishing itself as a competitive player in the international arms market.

options.text: Tank Production Upgrade [-2 Budget, -1 Energy Per Turn]
Bomber Production Upgrade [-3 Budget, -1 Energy Per Turn]
Fighter Production Upgrade [-3 Budget, -1 Energy Per Turn]
Support Vehicle Production Upgrade [-2 Budget, -1 Energy Per Turn]
Military Equipment Production Upgrade [-1 Budget, -1 Energy Per Turn]

Supporters of Sazon, along with reformists and activists, have flooded the streets, fearing that foul play is involved and accusing the government of attempting to sabotage the reform movement. The lack of information about Sazon's whereabouts is intensifying the unrest.

The Rizian Intelligence reports that a power struggle within the RPP has emerged in the wake of Sazon's disappearance and the party’s radical faction, led by Adarfo Sotelato, is gaining influence. The recent development of of Manus Sazon, leader of the Rizian People's Party (RPP), abruptly leaving the country to relocate to Kyrute has sparked a wave of protests across the country. While Sazon has not publicly explained his reasons, rumors are swirling that his sudden exit is due to mounting pressure from the government, leading many of his supporters to believe he was forced into exile. Protests have erupted across the country, with demonstrators accusing the government of driving Sazon out in an attempt to sabotage the reform movement.

The Rizian Intelligence reports that a power struggle within the RPP has emerged in the wake of Sazon's departure and the party’s radical faction, led by Adarfo Sotelato, is gaining influence. This group is calling for more aggressive action against the monarchy and capitalizing on the growing frustration and uncertainty surrounding Sazon's abrupt departure.
hubTitle: Protests and Leadership Struggle Over Sazon's Departure

name: Turn07_Decision_Manus_Gone_SentToWar

description:
The recent deployment of Manus Sazon, leader of the Rizian People's Party (RPP), to the front lines in the war against the Grand Duchy of Pales has sparked a wave of protests across the country. Although Sazon publicly gave a speech assuring the people that his decision to fight for the Rizian Armed Forces was voluntary, his supporters remain unconvinced. Many protesters suspect the government orchestrated his deployment to remove him from the political stage and undermine the reform movement.

The Rizian Intelligence reports that a power struggle within the RPP has emerged in the wake of Sazon's departure and the party’s radical faction, led by Adarfo Sotelato, is gaining influence. This group is calling for an immediate ceasefire and more aggressive action against the monarchy, capitalizing on the growing frustration with the war and the legitimacy of Sazon’s deployment.

During the week, the Rizian People's Party and various other opposition groups organized large-scale rallies in all major cities in Rizia, resulting in mass attendance from the public. Hundreds of thousands are demanding to be given the right to elect their political leaders and influence Rizian policy. The rallies have been peaceful and are being held in support of the RPP and Manus Sazon's calls for writing a new constitution to democratize the Kingdom by empowering the House of Delegates.

The revolutionary forces have overpowered the monarchist regime and took control of Kanthapur. This victory set off a chain reaction, with Ragkara and Penguvi quickly falling into revolutionary hands. The Battle of Tamaren marked the end of monarchist resistance, culminating in their surrender and the rise of the Free Republic of Vendosia in Suryanagara. The new government ushered in sweeping social democratic reforms and radical changes, reshaping every aspect of the previous political and social landscape. 

The streets of Kanthapur, once a bastion of monarchist power, now echo with revolutionary songs, as the people face a future filled with hope and uncertainty in equal measure.

description:
The civil war in Vendonesam evolved into a prolonged stalemate, where neither side could clinch a decisive victory. Kanthapur remained under monarchist control, while Suryanagara continued its resilient stand, despite the ebb and flow of Rizian support. The drawn-out battles for Ragkara and Penguvi became symbols of the enduring impasse, with each side gaining and losing ground in a seemingly endless cycle. In Tamaren, this deadlock played out fiercely, with constant skirmishes and strategic maneuvers yielding little change in control. 

The nation, divided and war-weary, yearned for a resolution, but as days turned into months, and months into years, the conflict became a part of daily life, with no clear end in sight.

description: With Rusty Montoro out of the picture and Rizian Royal Gold fully nationalized, the monarchy must decide the company’s new direction. The choice will impact control over the kingdom’s gold reserves, worker morale, and the influence of private interests moving forward.

name: Turn09_Decision_RumburgPeaceSummit

name: Turn09_Decision_StockExchangeResults
title: Porte Drazon Stock Exchange Opens
description:
The Porte Drazon Stock Exchange has officially opened its doors, marking a historic moment for the economy. International investors flood in, eager to capitalize on Rizian industries, while major domestic companies debut their listings. 

The initial performance of the exchange will set the tone for market confidence, treasury balances, and long-term economic growth. The results are now in.

name: Turn09_Decision_SuOmina_Fights_PalesResistance
title: Deploying Su Omina to Occupied Cities
description: Reports indicate that civilian unrest is brewing in the Palesian cities under our occupation. Small-scale protests and acts of defiance are escalating, threatening to grow into organized resistance. Su Omina could be deployed to restore order, but their methods are feared as much as they are effective. Should we send them in to crush dissent, or take a more restrained approach?
hubTitle: Deploying Su Omina to Occupied Cities

options.text: Limit their actions to intelligence gathering

name: Turn09_Decision_TourismCampaignResults
title: Tourism Campaign Results
description:
Following the nationwide push to promote Porte Drazon as a premier tourist destination, the latest reports reveal the campaign’s impact. Visitor numbers, economic activity, and public perception are being assessed. 

The success of this initiative will determine whether the city has solidified itself as a global attraction or struggled to draw interest.

options.text: Underwhelming turnout. Limited impact on tourism

name: Turn09_Decision_Unification
title: Rizian-Palesian Unification Initiative
description: After a series of successful meetings between Palesian and Rizian foreign ministers, Duke Axel announced that the path to unification of Rizia and Pales is now a possibility. He signalled his desire to join Rizia as a semi-autonomous region, and requested us to establish a Ministry of Unification to work with their Palesian counterparts to prepare both countries for a potential unification.

options.text: Agree to the plans and fund the Ministry of Unification [-2 Budget]
Agree to the plans, but ask Pales to fund the Ministry

name: Turn09_Decision_War_Both_InternalDissent
title: Quelling Dissent
description: As the casualties increase, opposition to the war is on the rise. Unrest among the populace in Rizia is leading to protests and anti-war propaganda. Unless we undertake action, the situation might spiral out of control.

options.text: Order police to disperse protests [-1 Authority]
Offer one time payment to families of those enlisted [-2 Budget]

name: Turn09_Decision_War_Both_PalesInfrastructureCollapse
title: Pales Infrastructure Collapse
description: The ongoing war has left Pales' critical infrastructure in ruins due to bombings and military engagements. Vital facilities, including water treatment plants, power stations, and transportation network have been severely damaged, causing widespread service outages, with many fearing a humanitarian crisis.

options.text: Open corridors for international humanitarian aid [-1 Authority]
Strengthen the blockade against Pales [-250 Military Manpower]
Send Rizian humanitarian aid under military escort [-1 Budget, -250 Military Manpower]

name: Turn09_Decision_War_Skipped_Experimental_Weapons_Again

name: Turn10_Decision_Ceasefire
title: Pales Offers Peace
description:
After Queen Livingston's talks with Duke Reinhart, the Grand Duchy has reached out to us through official channels, offering an immediate ceasefire to discuss a peace treaty between our countries. 

The offered peace treaty dictates the immediate withdrawal of Rizian and Palesian forces from the frontline, return of all occupied territories, the safe return of displaced populations and hostages; and most importantly agreeing to the pre-war borders between the two countries.

description: My future in Sordland is in doubt. It may be the right time to diversify my resources by keeping my money reserves safely abroad in the case of an unexpected departure.

name: Turn10_Decision_PalesReconstruction_Annex_DariaPM
title: Reconstruction of the Province of Pales
description:
Prime Minister Daria de Rava has reached out for your input regarding the approach to rebuilding the province of Pales. With full control over its gas fields, Pales holds great resource potential, but the war-torn infrastructure limits efficient extraction. The local population, now recognized as Rizian citizens, awaits assistance for integration. 

Prime Minister de Rava proposes two options: an immediate full-scale investment for rapid reconstruction, which would boost output but strain the budget, or a gradual rebuild in installments, allowing room for other pressing budgetary needs. She’s eager to hear your perspective.
hubTitle: Reconstruction of the Province of Pales
